apply_rules: Apply in the listed order on the RAW content (context=edit). Every "old" matches content.rendered exactly once at its turn (matches_in_live), except "replace_all" entries, which match exactly "expect_matches" times.

Edits with "spans_tags": true replace a whole <table> element: if "old" does not match the raw content exactly (raw line breaks between tags can differ), locate the single <table> element that contains "anchor" and replace that element with "new".

Every other old string sits inside one paragraph, list item or table cell and holds no HTML entity. The rendered content shows straight quotes (ש"ח, מ"ר) and no texturized characters, so raw and rendered text are expected to be identical inside a paragraph; re-check each old against the raw content right before applying.

tier 1 = sale-price alignment with the official list (conflicts, stale and unsourced sale figures); tier 2 = rent or other figures with no dated source. Applying tier 1 alone is valid (tier 2 olds do not overlap tier 1 results).
All or nothing per page: if any old does not match, write nothing. Re-fetch the page first; another session may have edited it. Data only: nothing here was applied.
notes: Every city-level 3/4/5-room figure on this page is consistent with the official medians (the 4-room 3.3-3.5M sits at the 1% edge of 3,289,900; the 3.7M city average is +3.7% from the all-deals median 3,567,200), so the lead, the quick-answer table and the FAQ stay as they are. The only tier-1 change is the main rooms table: its 'common price range' column (no source of any kind, with 2-2.5-room and 6+-room ranges the official data cannot support) becomes the official median column; the market-reference column stays. Edits 3 and 4 (renovation cost ranges with no source) are tier 2. Not audited as claims (illustrations or explicit hypotheticals): 4,250,000 listing / 3,600,000 deal in p@5525, 31,000 vs 35,000 per m2 in p@8719, 2,850,000 in p@11929, 300,000 gap in p@16415, 3.32M in p@18402, the 3,350,000 / 300,000 / 3,650,000 / 3,600,000 example in p@18666, the 3,700,000 / 7,500-8,500 / 10,000-11,000 if-example in p@19931, 200,000 in p@21775, 250,000 in tr@24155, the 3,300,000-3,500,000 / 3,950,000 example in p@25642, the 3,310,000 / 3,395,000 / 3,600,000 / 250,000 / 3,850,000 example in p@26305, 3,500,000 in p@28405, 3,800,000 / 3,400,000-3,550,000 in p@30996, 100,000-500,000 in p@33799. Remaining SUSPECT lines in check.py: the single-deal examples 3,395,000 and 3,600,000 for 5 rooms (the rooms table and FAQ p@30646; the same two deals as p@7435, read in the market on 05.06.2026, undated by the page itself) and the explicit if-example 3,700,000 in p@19931. 'מרכז דרום' (a market-source area, all rooms) is kept: it is not clearly the official 'מרכז' (3=3,016,100, 4=3,137,100), so no official figure was put in its place. Official medians also exist for קריית דוד רמז, נווה זמר, קזן, לסטר/רבוצקי, לב הפארק and קריית שרת, which the page does not name; nothing was added for them.
